recommendation: accept prototype for independent coordinator review only
reason: Differential parity, snapshot poison preservation, unchanged shared and fragmented copy paths, repeatable complete-frame CPU gains, conservative CPU gate passes all workloads.

tests.existingFocusedTests: 7 native framing tests passed on original and candidate. No claim for whole host suite. Filter avoids provider/preflight/network/credential operations. Host-loading, live, discovery and native-output tests read but not run.
tests.memoryScript: Existing verify_native_decoder_memory.mjs passed on each frozen full module: 1MiB body, 32KiB chunks, 3 rounds, expect-bounded. Shared native-frame-memory.test.mjs read but not executed; equivalent underlying command run explicitly with --source for each variant.
fixtures: every split across Unicode multi-message input
offset byte arrays, Buffer, shared-backed Buffer/views and cross realm arrays
empty/partial/header-only, invalid types and invalid headers
malformed UTF-8, BOM, invalid JSON, scalar JSON, escaped lone surrogate
at limit and one below, header/body split maximum frames
mutation-after-error, fragmented/shared mutation, repeated errors on nonempty pushes, empty push returns [], finish truncation, good messages coalesced before/after bad
2000 seeded random-byte body cases with follow-up push/finish

allocationCounts.scope: Synchronous decoder.push only. Constructor/header allocation excluded. Logical requested bytes and explicit set operations; not physical RAM. Instrumentation restored in finally.

benchmarkPlan.gate: Reject if any workload median paired CPU candidate/original exceeds 1.05 in both initial and independent repeat, or any repeat exceeds 1.10. Require differential and GC parity. Allocation reduction alone is insufficient.
benchmarkPlan.repeat: Always run a second full pass, retain all samples including warmups.
benchmarkPlan.scope: Full frozen modules; one live decoder reused per sample; owned synthetic memory only. CPU process.cpuUsage and wall performance.now; no instrumentation. Byte sizes are UTF-8 body sizes. Alternating order each pair.

failedTrials.name: first GC measurement
failedTrials.failure: assert retained >= 1MiB failed. Before sample could include prior poisoned decoder which then became unreachable, so net process-wide ArrayBuffer delta was not body retention.
failedTrials.correction: Keep every measured decoder strongly reachable throughout the eight scenarios. Corrected run and independent corrected rerun passed. Candidate unchanged.

behavior.errors: Compared error name, message and code; not error stack identity. Invalid data snapshots remain owned. Nonempty follow-up repeats error; empty follow-up returns []; finish reports truncation.
behavior.snapshot: One Buffer.alloc(length) plus set on direct-view parse/decode failure. Shared-backed inputs always copy first. No retained caller view after successful or failed push.
behavior.encodeMessage: Byte-identical along with every byte outside NativeDecoder.

cpuObjectionsAndLimits: Not a reusable TextDecoder prototype. Decoder construction remains per message.
Medians for fragmented and mixed are close to parity; individual fragmented pairs include >5% regressions. Gate applies repeatable median CPU regression; raw outliers retained.
Measurements are single-machine warmed synthetic in-process loops, with reused decoder per sample. Runtime imports and frame encoding are outside timing, full-module decoder is inside timing.
No statistical confidence interval, affinity, frequency control or isolated machine. Other activity may affect timings. No provider latency or browser memory claim.
Malformed/shared inputs still allocate/copy, and failure recovery adds branch/catch work; error-path throughput not benchmarked.
Logical Buffer request/copy counts exclude TextDecoder/JSON internal allocations. Forced-GC arrayBuffers and weak references are evidence of retention, not physical RAM savings.
Candidate adds 15 lines and duplicates decode/parse sequence. Coordinator should weigh maintenance cost against CPU gains.
acceptanceGaps: No installed Breezer, app, native build, real stdio host, Chromium, provider, profiles, credentials or accounts exercised.
Only pinned macOS arm64 Node24.22.1 measured; other supported Node versions, Windows and Linux require acceptance.
No concurrent writer racing SharedArrayBuffer; existing copy path retained for shared inputs.
No instrumentation monkeypatch/subclass side-effect or out-of-memory equivalence claim.

Preserved initial runner bounds direct children with execFileSync timeout and SIGKILL, but lacks explicit worker process-group cleanup on timeout; no timeout occurred. Final verification uses detached process groups with explicit cleanup and in-process tests. See REPRODUCE.txt.
